title: Bismillah hussain
body:
Allahu akbar, allahu akbar.. hussain hussain hussain..(2)
ba waqt asr karbala, raazi ba zuljanah(2)..(2)
pusht e zuljanah pe (fateh khaibar ka laal)..(2)
aayi sada e ghaib, zehra ke noore ayn
shehenshah e mashraqain
<<MINI>>
bismillah husssain....
<<DIVIDER>>
Marhaba, marhaba...
shahe karbobala
aagaye hai ali aur rasool e khuda
apni sawari rann ko badhao
<<DIVIDER>>
tegh uthao ya hussain
fatah e lashkar, ho ibn e haider
sabko batao ya hussain
<<MINI>>
bismillah husssain....
<<DIVIDER>>
Teghe yadullahi
hai shuja e arab
deene Mohammad ki
tu baqa ka sabab
<<DIVIDER>>
shane imamat, shane qayadat
teri wirasat ya hussain
ye fauje aada, yaad karegi
teri shuja'at ya hussain
<<MINI>>
bismillah husssain....
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab ke tera faras
rann ki janib chala
jaan bachane laga
lashkare ashqiya
<<DIVIDER>>
rann ko ulatkar, maida'n palatkar
tune dikhaya ya hussain
khandaq o khaibar, badr ka manzar
yaad dilaya ya hussain
<<MINI>>
bismillah husssain....
<<DIVIDER>>
Tegh teri chali
hashr barpa hua
ek hone laga
maimana maisara
<<DIVIDER>>
tegho pe teghe, dhalo pe dhaale
lasho pe laashe yaa hussain
sehmi hui thi, bikhri hui thi
faujo ki saansein yaa hussain
<<MINI>>
bismillah husssain....
<<DIVIDER>>
Shaah ladte rahe
shaah ladte rahe
jung ko dekhne
ambiya aagaye
<<DIVIDER>>
pyaas ke aalam, mein ye ladai
tera jigar hai yaa hussain
tune bataya, ke shere dawar
ka tu pisar hai yaa hussain
<<MINI>>
bismillah husssain....
<<DIVIDER>>
Daf'atan ruk gaye
daste shahe huda
aayi aflaak se
irja'ee ki sadaa
<<DIVIDER>>
rabb tera tujhse, raazi hua hai
aao palat kar yaa hussain
sajda e akhir, ka waqt hai ye
mehbub e daawar yaa hussain
<<MINI>>
bismillah husssain....
<<DIVIDER>>
Teer chalte the kahi se kahi naize hai chale
pusht e rahwaar se shabbir sare farsh gire
darr se khaime ke bahen dekh rahi thi dukhiya aur sakina ki sadaa thi mere baba, baba
hashr barpa hua salman o raza
aayi jab fatima zehra ki sadaa
<<MINI>>
haye pyaasa hussain, hussain
haye pyaasa hussain, hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmi zee'n zakhmi sarr
khaak par tera sarr
<<MINI>>
haye pyaasa hussain, hussain
haye pyaasa hussain, hussain
